title: Rav Sheva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Horayot 5b](https://www.sefaria.org/Horayot.5b.16): he raised a difficulty against Rav Kahana.
We also find Rav bar Sheva in Berakhot 11, Rava bar Sheva in [Shabbat 140](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.140a.6), or Ravin bar Sheva in [Chullin 48](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.48a.3).

notes.text: The [printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=275) gives שבא and Genesis 25:3, where the supplied transcription has שבע and 25:13. Genesis names Sheba son of Yokshan.

Hyman cites Berakhot 11; the corresponding mention of Rav bar Sheva is at [Berakhot 14a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.14a.5-6). [Heilprin’s Rav Sheva entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3268&lang=en) cites the Horayot conversation with Rav Kahana.
